author: The Hated One
description:
The real reason for everything - surveillance, crackdown, border control, geopolitical instability. Support my independent work: https://www.patreon.com/thehatedone 

The men above you convinced you that it is necessary to put up a mass surveillance state for your protection – surveillance not even you can escape from. Why do you think that is?

Step inside your car and every mile you take will be tracked with precision and tied to your identity. Step outside and escape to the woods? Tens of thousands of disguised motion-triggered cameras will follow your every step. Wanna hit the gym to get into shape? Government spies will buy your data and location from your fitness tracker.  What do you think they need all that data for?

title: THIS is why they've been doing it all along!
